CLI.faq1Q: How do I install AI agent skills with the CLI?
CLI.faq1A: Run npx killer-skills add owner/repo in your project directory. The CLI auto-detects your IDE and writes the correct skill format.
CLI.faq2Q: Which IDEs does the CLI support?
CLI.faq2A: The CLI supports 19+ environments including Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, JetBrains, Trae, and more.
CLI.faq3Q: Can I sync skills across multiple projects?
CLI.faq3A: Yes. Use killer-skills sync to keep skills updated across repos. The CLI handles format conversion automatically.
CLI.faq4Q: How do I update installed skills?
CLI.faq4A: Run killer-skills update to pull the latest versions. The CLI preserves your local customizations.

Solutions.faq2Q: Können diese Skills direkt in Cursor oder Claude Code installiert werden?
Solutions.faq2A: Ja. Die hier aufgeführten Skills unterstützen den einheitlichen Killer-Skills-Installationsablauf für Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf und andere IDEs.
Solutions.faq3Q: Was tun, wenn die Ergebnisse zu breit sind?
Solutions.faq3A: Öffnen Sie Skill-Detailseiten, um Keywords und Anwendungsfälle zu prüfen, und verfeinern Sie dann mit spezifischen Begriffen wie Plattformnamen, Dateitypen oder Geschäftsaktionen.
Solutions.pageDescription: Durchsuchen Sie installierbare AI-Agent-Skills nach Use-Cases: Workflow-, Prozess-, Dokument-, Browser- und Datenautomation.
Solutions.faq1Q: Why use solution pages instead of ad-hoc keyword searches?
Solutions.faq1A: Solution pages bundle high-intent terms, installable skills, and next-step paths to improve click quality and reduce noisy browsing.

IntegrationsPage.faq1A: Killer-Skills supports 19+ environments including Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, JetBrains, Trae, OpenClaw, Kiro, Augment Code, Continue, Codex, OpenCode, Goose, and more.
IntegrationsPage.faq2Q: Do I need to configure each IDE separately?
IntegrationsPage.faq2A: No. The CLI auto-detects your IDE and writes the correct native skill format. Zero manual configuration needed.
IntegrationsPage.faq3Q: Can the same skill work across different IDEs?
IntegrationsPage.faq3A: Yes. Killer-Skills uses a unified skill format that automatically converts to each IDE native configuration.
